subject: Storage add-on added mid-cycle — VAT ID update & invoice split
messages:
From: Emma Wallace <emma@solarshift.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@solarshift.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New storage add-on mid-cycle — VAT ID updated, need invoice split

Hi Ava,

We turned on the extra storage add-on yesterday (Feb 13) to cover an urgent archival ingest. Can you confirm how Redwood will bill the partial month for the add-on? Our finance team also just updated our EU VAT ID (attached) and needs the invoice to reflect the new VAT registration number and the correct tax handling for intra-EU supply.

Specific asks:
- Split invoice: base subscription (Feb 1–28) + prorated storage add-on (Feb 13–28) on two line items if possible.
- Show VAT ID on the invoice and apply reverse-charge/exempt treatment if that’s the right flow for an EU-registered buyer.
- We’ll need a copy of the signed SOW on the invoice reference (attached).

Can you let me know the timing? We’re trying to close February payments this week.

Thanks,
Emma Wallace
Head of Procurement
SolarShift Ltd.
Attachments: signed-SOW-storage-addon.pdf (pdf), solarshift-vat-registration.pdf (pdf)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wallace <emma@solarshift.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New storage add-on mid-cycle — VAT ID updated, need invoice split

Hi Emma — thanks for the attachments and the heads up.

Quick confirmation on process from our side: we can issue a single invoice that contains two line items (base subscription + prorated add-on) or two separate invoices if your AP requires separate documents. Either way we can surface the new VAT ID on the bill and apply the appropriate EU tax treatment — I’ll need a copy of your VAT certificate (the PDF you attached looks like the local registration number; we’ll confirm with tax).

Next steps:
- I’ve looped in Billing and Payments (Rishi) and Finance Ops (Monica) to prepare the invoice split and confirm VAT handling.
- Please confirm whether AP wants one invoice with two lines vs two invoices. If you need them separate we can issue an interim pro-rated invoice for the add-on and a monthly invoice for the subscription.

I’ll come back with a proposed invoice and timeline by tomorrow EOD.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: New storage add-on mid-cycle — VAT ID updated, need invoice split

Folks — forwarding SolarShift request. Summary: they enabled a storage add-on on Feb 13; want either a split-invoice or a two-line invoice showing prorated charge for Feb 13–28. They attached a signed SOW and a VAT doc; they say AP is closing Feb payments this week.

Constraints / ask:
- Can Billing produce a two-line invoice (subscription + prorated add-on) and show the new VAT ID so their bookkeeping accepts it?
- If the VAT handling needs reverse-charge, can we annotate the invoice accordingly and include our supplier VAT as needed?
- If separate invoices are simpler, we can issue a pro-rated add-on invoice now and the full monthly invoice on Feb 28. They prefer single doc but AP can accept two if required.

Background: deal HS-987654 (SolarShift Ltd.) — they’re EU-registered (attached doc). Customer is requesting the VAT ID update be reflected on the Feb billing.

Thanks — can you take point? I put Rishi on so he can confirm timing and any impact to payment collection.

— Ava

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Emma Wallace <emma@solarshift.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New storage add-on mid-cycle — VAT ID updated, need invoice split

Hi all —

Thanks for raising this. Billing can do a two-line invoice that shows: (1) subscription for Feb 1–28 at the agreed monthly rate and (2) prorated storage add-on for Feb 13–28. We will include the new VAT ID from the attached certificate and mark the invoice with the appropriate reverse-charge note: "VAT reverse charge – customer VAT ID applied."

Action items we completed:
- Generated draft split invoice and attached as PDF: redwood-split-invoice-Feb2027.pdf (see attachment).
- Added reference to signed SOW and HubSpot deal HS-987654.
- If SolarShift prefers separate documents, we can void the split invoice and issue an immediate pro-rated add-on invoice plus the regular subscription invoice on Feb 28.

Timing: draft attached now; final signed invoice will be issued after Emma confirms single vs separate invoice and we confirm the VAT certificate validity (we verified registration number format but will keep a note for tax team).

Payment collection: if you want us to initiate payment collection now, confirm whether AP will pay the single invoice immediately. If they need Net30 from invoice date, please confirm terms.

Emma — let me know which invoice format AP prefers and whether I should finalize now.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-split-invoice-Feb2027.pdf (pdf)
